desc: Derive and verify the prefix and suffix distinct-count computations.
Design the segment-tree initialization for all first split positions \(i\), representing `prefix[i] + distinct(i+1..current_j)`.
Prove the range-update interval for each new value using its previous occurrence, including boundary handling.
Implement the \(O(N\log N)\) lazy segment tree with range addition and global maximum queries.
Check non-empty segment constraints, input/output handling, and integer answer bounds.
